method: Estimated feature-scope completion, not hours remaining. Sum the weights of verified milestones; remaining_percent = 100 - verified_weight. Implemented but unverified work earns no completed weight. Weights total 100 and stay fixed unless explicitly documented scope changes require a new baseline.
baseline_evidence: Playable 2.3.7 source 2c78c64f49b38209090a7bb10f122dea6d50531c; Android 35/36 run 37764185028; prior feature evidence in docs/VALIDATION.md and versioned change notes.
